ROUTING (framework/CATEGORIES_v0_8.md): taps and showers = G3 (finished fitting installed in a home; 'tap' named in the C8 precedence); sanitaryware/WCs/basins = G3 (fitted bathrooms); door and window locks = B8 (B8 test and G3 precedence); pipe, fittings, valves, traps, drainage, guttering = C8; door handles, hinges, knockers, latches = C8 ironmongery (kinds file). So Armitage Shanks, Twyford Bathrooms, Kohler, Grohe, Hansgrohe, Dornbracht, Toto, Roca, Ideal Standard, Delta, Moen, Pfister etc. go to G3; Watts, Sloan Valve, John Guest, Genuit, Sioux Chief, Viega-type makers stay C8; lock makers to B8. Wood flooring (Boen, Junckers, Dinesen and the 25 Archello rows) is a fitted floor = G3 unless sold as loose boards; flag for owner if the C8 kinds file is meant to hold it. HOMONYMS: Crown Paints Kenya is not UK Crown Paints; Marco Polo tiles vs Marco Polo apparel (A1); Vitra tiles (Turkey) vs Vitra furniture; Kale tiles vs Kale locks; Twyford (Keda Africa tiles) vs Twyford Bathrooms; KCC (Korea) vs other KCCs; Talavera de la Reyna (Puebla workshop) vs Talavera de la Reina (Spanish town).
